U.note: Huge clear clock, drift-free deadline timing, labelled Pause/Resume, live-region and keyboard shortcuts, good phone layout; a bit padded with presets, undo toast and persistence.

V.note: Bold red full-bleed with big mono clock and mode shown, solid timing and live region, but the phase pills are inert li elements and the confirm-reset and odd skip logic add friction.

W.note: Compact dark card with ring, working tabs and settings in very little code and accurate deadline timing; no aria-live or timer role and the pause state is only the button label.

X.note: Warm, polished and accessible with good state messages, but the giant pomodoro count outranks the clock and the page is overbuilt with persistence, settings and a hacked-in inline-styled button.

Y.note: Large ring with clear time, mode tabs and settings, correct deadline timing in tiny readable code; no screen-reader announcements, and skip keeps running into the next phase.

Z.note: Big readable clock and thorough announcements, but the monospaced text-heavy look is plain, reset needs a confirm press even when merely paused, and two reset buttons plus notifications overbuild it.
